learnings.rule: Never put internal planning IDs, ticket numbers, or decision tags (e.g. 'owner decision D1') inside source comments; state only the technical constraint.
Test assertions on rendered HTML or text must target specific elements or structured values, never short substrings that match unrelated CSS or boilerplate.
Never add vertical left accent bars on cards, rows, callouts or selected items; convey emphasis with background tint, icon, font weight or full border.
